message: provider configuration aws deploys to us-west-2 (region taken from the region attribute or ARNs of its resources), and costgate has no price snapshot of us-west-2; 4 resources in us-west-2 left unpriced (reason region)
fix: run 'costgate pricing refresh --region us-west-2 --out us-west-2.json.gz', then rerun with --pricing us-west-2.json.gz
